description: Address code review issues: fix JWT hardcoded fallback, weight unit mismatch, Prisma singleton, SubjectCard duplicated logic, and Vercel serverless deployment
steps: Remove hardcoded JWT_SECRET fallback and create getJwtSecret() helper that throws if env var is missing
Create Prisma singleton in packages/backend/src/lib/prisma.ts and update all route files to use it
Fix weight unit mismatch: update backend Zod schemas to accept 0-100 integers instead of 0-1 decimals
Update gradeCalculator service and tests to work with integer percentages (0-100)
Update SubjectCard to use backend-computed calculatedAverage and component.average instead of duplicating calculation logic
Create Vercel serverless function at api/index.ts wrapping the Express app
Update vercel.json to route /api/* to the serverless function
Add calculatedAverage and average fields to shared TypeScript interfaces
Update backend index.ts to conditionally start server (skip in Vercel environment)
acceptance_criteria: Server fails to start if JWT_SECRET env var is not set
Only one PrismaClient instance is created across all route files
Frontend can create subjects with component weights as integers (e.g., 60, 40) without backend validation errors
Frontend can create grades with weight as integers (e.g., 30) without backend validation errors
SubjectCard uses backend-computed averages from API response
Vercel deployment has a working /api route via serverless function
verification: npm test passes all 23 tests (18 backend + 5 frontend)
findings: The weight unit mismatch was the critical bug - frontend sent integers (30, 60, 40) but backend Zod schemas rejected anything above 1.0. Fixed by changing backend schemas to accept 1-100. The gradeCalculator math is identical since it divides weighted sums by total weights regardless of the scale. Vercel serverless function created at api/index.ts using @vercel/node to wrap the Express app.
